summary: Frontend-only hero scroll-video verification completed on public preview URL. Core scrub behavior, pause semantics, reverse scrubbing, sticky-to-services transition, CTA/dialog/nav interactions, reduced-motion behavior, and reload/resize synchronization passed. Two regressions found: blocked-asset fallback does not collapse to static track, and responsive hero composition overlaps media product at smaller breakpoints.

ui_bugs.issue: At 768x1024, heading and CTA region visibly overlap the media product area; requirement asked for non-overlapping heading/actions with media product.
At 320x568, secondary CTA is partially over the media area and compressed, reducing clarity/usability in cramped viewport.

integration_issues.flow: Video asset failure fallback (both /media/hero-scroll.mp4 and /media/hero-scroll.webm unavailable)
integration_issues.issue: Hero does not switch to static fallback mode. Track remains 'hero-scroll-track' (not 'hero-scroll-track--static'), video element remains mounted in loading state, and pinned scroll runway does not collapse.

issues: Tablet 768x1024 screenshot shows copy and buttons visually colliding with product render zone.
Cramped 320x568 screenshot shows CTA stack intruding into media area, weakening hierarchy/readability.

action_items: Implement explicit failure timeout/error fallback in ScrollVideo/useScrollVideo (or source-level error handling) so dual asset failure toggles hero-scroll-track--static.
Adjust tablet and cramped hero layout rules to keep heading/actions clear of product media region while preserving CTA usability.
Re-run blocked-assets scenario after fix to confirm static class application and collapsed runway behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: onFailure currently depends on media error path that is not reached in intercepted-failure state (readyState=0, networkState=3, no media error surfaced), leaving stage stuck in loading mode.
Reduced-motion path is correctly implemented: no video element rendered and no hero media request when reduce is active before load.
Scroll synchronization logic and quantized seeking are stable under rapid directional reversals in normal mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://subtle-motion-8.preview.emergentagent.com only. Desktop scrub checks passed: 0/25/50/100% mapped to ~0/2.5/5/10s, paused at rest, reverse settle works, frame hashes differ, reload+resize sync passed, nav/CTA/dialog interactions functional, and services/back-to-top path works. Reduced-motion passed (no video/request). Remaining failure is dual-asset blocked fallback not collapsing to static mode; responsive overlap concern visible at 768x1024 and 320x568 screenshots.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (HIGH): When both video assets fail to load, hero fallback does not activate because error transition is not triggered in this failure mode; component stays in loading state with full sticky runway. Repro: intercept/abort /media/hero-scroll.mp4 and /media/hero-scroll.webm on reload -> track class remains hero-scroll-track, stage data-state=loading after >5s, video still mounted. Mitigation: add deterministic fail-safe timer/networkState guard and source-level failure aggregation to call onFailure and collapse track. RCA-2 (layout): Tablet/cramped breakpoints place copy/CTA block within media product region; adjust hero-video-stage sizing/top or copy max-width/spacing for those breakpoints.
